positive.point: Customers asking about business wellbeing can indicate emotional investment and support, potentially leading to word-of-mouth promotion.
Responding to all reviews, both positive and negative, can improve online reputation and customer trust.
Timing matters when asking for reviews; asking immediately after a positive experience increases the likelihood of receiving a review.
Gamifying the review process and integrating it into the customer experience can increase review collection consistency.

negative.point: Fake or negative reviews can significantly impact business reputation and lead to loss of potential clients.
Yelp is often criticized for being unhelpful to business owners and is perceived as review extortion.
Obtaining useful feedback from clients and employees is challenging, with surveys often yielding only extreme positive or negative responses.
The pressure to maintain a high volume of positive reviews can be stressful for business owners.
